# Vendored Spreadsheet ZIP Reader

fflate 0.8.3, copied unchanged from the package's esm/browser.js.

Source: https://github.com/101arrowz/fflate
License: MIT, included in fflate.LICENSE.

Used synchronously to read Excel OOXML ZIP entries. No network service or worker is required. Upload limits and worksheet/field validation are implemented in spreadsheet_input.mjs.
